generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A requirement extractor filters Markdown list items by a narrow lexical heuristic before coverage validation, so legitimate obligations can disappear and the validator can still report complete coverage against the truncated candidate set.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat only list items whose first verb matches a maintained keyword set as obligations and reuse that same derived candidate set as the denominator for completeness.

reusable_control.procedure: Independently enumerate list items under normative headings, exclude explicit non-normative headings, and compare source identity tuples against the closure; removal of any normative item must fail the gate.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Under a normative Markdown section, treat each list item as a requirement candidate independently of its opening verb; explicit non-normative sections must be excluded by section semantics rather than lexical coincidence.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The audit preflight must rederive normative list-item coverage with an implementation independent from the producer extractor and fail before saturation when any source-line tuple is absent from the closure.

transfer_cases.observed: A normative scope list with uncommon imperative verbs is fully retained while an explicit non-normative section is excluded.
An independent consumer rejects a closure with one missing list item under a requirements heading.
